inherited_oracle: All required source/control dimensions must pass before any candidate pixel is opened, because the admitted canary must distinguish rigid terrain, Earth-linked glare or bloom, a cabin/window-only effect, and an external diffuse anomaly.

dimensions.evidence: The released PCD3 transcript and labels bind Koch's report to art002a000015 at 23:22:39.010 UTC; the PCD3 assignment includes Koch and Wiseman.
The bounded Atlas response returns 40 D5 raw frames from 23:22:37.530 through 23:22:49.330 UTC. Five exposure-bracket frames begin 0.020 to 0.390 seconds after the transcript report time.
Repeated five-exposure D5 brackets span the report and subsequent Earth emergence, providing a same-camera temporal sequence if a later gate were admitted.
NASA mapped Al-Biruni and Goddard rim topography in art002e009280, but the event burst lacks released exact geometry and the report documents a 14.2-second camera/render discrepancy.
NASA tags Koch as using a camera and the event frames use D5 serial 3500015 at 400 mm, but product labels do not identify the operator, exact eye/viewfinder state, or window for each frame.

The exact transcript documents active attempts to cover cabin reflections and persistent sunlight reflection. NASA says the full three-pane window stack was not characterized preflight and can distort images. No event-specific optical transfer or reflection control is released.

The only external raw-image hit in the bounded window is SAW Cam 3 at 23:22:44 UTC, 4.99 seconds after the report. Its GoPro exposure is about 0.000384 seconds at ISO 100 and -2 EV, with a different viewpoint and no demonstrated faint-source sensitivity equivalence to the D5 or human view.
The current PDS mission page marks the Artemis II SPICE bundle delayed. Existing report photogrammetry is useful but does not supply exact released geometry for every event frame.

The released handheld and SAW products do not establish a calibrated response or detection threshold for an extended faint limb source. NASA's report recommends a dedicated low-light limb camera for confident detection or non-detection.

admission_rule: ADMIT only when every required dimension is PASS.
